access_count.description_en: The number of times the share has been accessed
access_count.title: 访问次数

created_at.description_en: The time when the share was created
created_at.title: 创建时间

disable_download.description_en: Specifies whether to disable downloading of files in the share
disable_download.description_zh: 禁止下载分享中的文件
disable_download.title: 禁止下载分享中的文件

disable_preview.description_en: Specifies whether to disable previewing of files in the share
disable_preview.description_zh: 禁止预览分享中的文件
disable_preview.title: 禁止预览分享中的文件

disable_save.description_en: Specifies whether to disable saving of files in the share
disable_save.description_zh: 禁止转存分享中的文件
disable_save.title: 禁止转存分享中的文件

download_count.description_en: The number of times the share has been downloaded
download_count.title: 下载次数

download_limit.description_en: The maximum number of times the share can be downloaded
download_limit.title: 分享下载次数限制

expiration.description_en: The expiration time. The value is in RFC 3339 format, for example, "2020-06-28T11:33:00.000+08:00". An empty string ("") indicates that the share never expires
expiration.title: 到期时间

expired.description_en: Indicates whether the share has expired
expired.title: 是否过期

file_id_list.description_en: The list of file IDs in the shared parent path
file_id_list.title: 分享父路径文件id列表

office_editable.description_en: Specifies whether online editing of shared documents is allowed
office_editable.description_zh: 是否允许在线编辑分享的文档
office_editable.title: 是否允许在线编辑分享的文档

preview_count.description_en: The number of times the share has been previewed
preview_count.title: 预览次数

preview_limit.description_en: The maximum number of times the share can be previewed
preview_limit.title: 分享预览次数限制

report_count.description_en: The number of times the share has been reported
report_count.title: 被举报次数

save_count.description_en: The number of times the share has been saved
save_count.title: 转存次数

save_download_limit.description_en: The maximum total number of times the share can be saved and downloaded
save_download_limit.description_zh: 分享转存和下载次数总和限制
save_download_limit.title: 分享转存和下载次数总和限制

save_limit.description_en: The maximum number of times the share can be saved
save_limit.title: 分享转存次数限制

share_all_files.description_en: Indicates whether all files in the drive are shared
share_all_files.description_zh: 是否分享整个drive中的文件
share_all_files.title: 是否分享整个drive中的文件

share_name.description_en: The share name. By default, the name of the first file is used
share_name.description_zh: 分享名，默认使用第一个文件名
share_name.title: 分享名称

share_pwd.description_en: The extraction code, which is 0 to 64 characters in length. A length of 0 indicates that no extraction code is set
share_pwd.description_zh: 提取码，0-64个字符。长度0表示没有提取码
share_pwd.title: 分享密码

status.description_en:
The status of the share. Valid values:
disabled: Canceled.
enabled: Active
status.description_zh:
状态。
枚举值如下：
disabled（已取消）
enabled（有效）
status.title: 状态

updated_at.description_en: The time when the share was last modified
updated_at.title: 修改时间

video_preview_count.description_en: The number of times audio and video files in the share have been played
video_preview_count.title: 音视频播放次数

parameters.help_en: Set to `true` to allow users to create files in shared folders. Setting this to `true` also requires specifying `creatable_file_id_list`
parameters.help_zh: 允许在分享中的文件夹中创建文件；creatable为true时，需要同时传creatable_file_id_list参数
parameters.name: creatable

parameters.help_en: A list of folder IDs where users can upload files
parameters.help_zh: 允许上传的文件夹file id列表
parameters.name: creatable_file_id_list

parameters.help_en: A description for the share link, 0 to 1,024 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
分享描述。
长度范围[0, 1024]字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: Set to `true` to prevent users from downloading the shared files
parameters.help_zh: 禁止下载分享中的文件
parameters.name: disable_download

parameters.help_en: Set to `true` to prevent users from previewing the shared files
parameters.help_zh: 禁止预览分享中的文件
parameters.name: disable_preview

parameters.help_en: Set to `true` to prevent users from saving the shared files to their own drive
parameters.help_zh: 禁止转存分享中的文件
parameters.name: disable_save

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of times users can download the shared files. The value must be 0 or greater. A value of 0 means there is no limit
parameters.help_zh:
分享下载次数限制。
次数要求>=0。
次数0表示不限制
parameters.name: download_limit

parameters.help_en: The expiration time for the share link, specified in RFC 3339 format (for example, "2020-06-28T11:33:00.000+08:00"). To create a share link that never expires, set this parameter to an empty string ("")
parameters.help_zh:
失效时间点。
RFC3339格式，比如："2020-06-28T11:33:00.000+08:00"。
当expiration取值""时，表示永久有效
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en: A list of 1 to 100 file IDs to share. This parameter is required when `share_all_files` is `false` and is ignored when it is `true`
parameters.help_zh:
分享父路径文件id列表。
父路径文件个数范围[1, 100]。
如果`share_all_files=true`，那么此字段无效，否则必须要填写
parameters.name: file_id_list

parameters.help_en: Set to `true` to allow online editing of the shared documents
parameters.help_zh: 允许在线编辑分享的文档
parameters.name: office_editable

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of times users can preview the shared files. The value must be 0 or greater. A value of 0 means there is no limit
parameters.help_zh:
分享预览次数限制。
次数要求>=0。
次数0表示不限制
parameters.name: preview_limit

parameters.help_en: If `true`, users must log in to access the share link
parameters.help_zh: 登录后才允许访问分享
parameters.name: require_login

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of times users can save the shared files. The value must be 0 or greater. A value of 0 means there is no limit
parameters.help_zh:
分享转存次数限制。
次数要求>=0。
次数0表示不限制
parameters.name: save_limit

parameters.help_en: Set to `true` to share all files in the drive
parameters.help_zh: 是否分享整个drive中的文件
parameters.name: share_all_files

parameters.help_en: The share name. The length must be between 0 and 128 characters. If not specified, the system uses the name of the file corresponding to the first ID in `file_id_list`
parameters.help_zh:
分享名。
如果未设置，默认使用file_id_list中的第一个id对应的文件名。
长度范围[0, 128]字符
parameters.name: share_name

parameters.help_en: The password for the share link. It must be between 0 and 64 printable ASCII characters. If this parameter is not set or is an empty string, the share link does not require a password
parameters.help_zh:
提取码。
提取码长度范围[0, 64]字节
不设置或者设置为空表示无提取码，在获取分享令牌的时候也不用设置提取码参数。
要求使用ASCII可见字符
parameters.name: share_pwd

parameters.help_en: The user ID. This parameter is required when authenticating the request with an AccessKey (AK)
parameters.help_zh: 用户id。使用AK方式请求时，必填
parameters.name: user_id
